name: Post-Tutorial Varrock Museum Natural History Quiz proof segment

accomplishes: Documents the sourced, local quiz interactions below the existing Natural History Quiz completion action.
Preserves the distinction between the quiz completion record and separately observed Rune Mysteries progress or Museum claims.
account_applicability: The player observes that they want a fixed, no-player-provided-item Museum contribution fragment.
The player observes that a post-Tutorial account may reach the stated location and chooses to consider this activity.
purpose.timing_observation: These facts can make the fragment relevant to inspect, but they neither select it now nor rank it above any other eligible content.

source_catalog.used_for: Natural History Quiz location, Orlando Smith start and claim flow, 14 display mechanics, fixed rewards, and the separate Historian Minas Rune Mysteries claim.

assumptions: The player declares a post-Tutorial standard Ironman account state.
The player is present and may stop at any checkpoint.
No travel method, prior museum visit, quest start, quest completion, item acquisition, or combat result is assumed.

geographic_checkpoint.description: The sourced quiz location is the first basement floor of Varrock Museum.

coverage.boundary: The canonical action records quiz completion, not arrival or travel to the museum.

bank_checkpoint.description: This fact record lists no player-provided quiz items or coins; it does not require, assert, or model a bank interaction.

coverage.boundary: An empty exact item and GP requirement is not evidence of a bank visit or of bank contents.

checkpoints.description: A Rune Mysteries start or partial-progress checkpoint may be recorded externally by the player, but this account model has no start/progress state for it.

coverage.boundary: It cannot establish Rune Mysteries completion, Historian Minas claim eligibility, a normalized completion action, or an applied transition.

checkpoints.description: A player-observed Rune Mysteries completion can be supplied separately when considering the Museum claim action.

coverage.boundary: The fact supports the claim relationship only; it does not supply the quest's path, start, items, skill checks, completion, or claim observation.

execution_steps.instruction: Reach the sourced Natural History Quiz location on the Varrock Museum first basement floor.

coverage.boundary: Travel routing and arrival are below the normalized action and are not represented as completed state.

execution_steps.instruction: Talk to Orlando Smith and receive the lecture before answering display plaques.

coverage.boundary: This interaction does not by itself prove any completed display, fixed reward, or normalized action completion.

execution_steps.instruction: Answer the three required questions for each of the 14 Natural History Quiz displays, then talk to Orlando Smith for the stated full-quiz claim condition.

coverage.boundary: The documented mechanics support the instruction, but the player must separately observe whether every answer and the final conversation occurred.

execution_steps.instruction: Only after the player observes full quiz completion may they record the linked normalized Natural History Quiz completion through its separate confirmation workflow.

coverage.boundary: This segment never applies the action. The linked action is a coarse completion record and does not capture travel, individual answers, quest starts, or external quest progress.

branches.when: Only when the player separately observes Rune Mysteries completed and deliberately selects the Museum claim interaction.

steps.instruction: Only after the player observes the separate Historian Minas interaction may they record the linked normalized claim action through its separate confirmation workflow.

coverage.boundary: The claim action cannot prove Rune Mysteries start or completion, and it cannot turn an unmodeled partial-quest checkpoint into a completed quest.
The branch is an optional factual claim relationship, not a recommendation to complete Rune Mysteries or claim Kudos now.

player_risk_requirements: The player must decide whether their current account mode and risk tolerance permit leaving their present activity and travelling to the Museum.
current_observations_required: The player must currently observe their own location, supplies, account mode, and any travel risk before moving.
No death, escape, safe travel, or successful return is assumed from the absence of a sourced quiz hazard.

passive_recurring_checks.trigger_when: A player notices a possible passive or recurring timer while considering this segment.
passive_recurring_checks.required_current_observation: The player confirms the timer or opportunity is currently available and independently decides whether it is worth handling.
passive_recurring_checks.interruption_policy: Do not leave a quest, Slayer task, combat encounter, or other committed activity merely because a timer may be ready; defer the check until a player-chosen safe stopping point.

stop_conditions: Stop before any step when the player does not want to continue.
Stop the optional Rune Mysteries claim branch unless its external completion and separate interaction are both player-observed.
reentry_conditions: Re-enter the quiz fragment only after returning to the sourced Museum location and re-observing the intended checkpoint.
Re-enter the Rune Mysteries claim branch only after separately observing its completion state and choosing the claim interaction.

estimated_time.uncertainty: The supplied fact record does not establish a bounded completion time, and this package does not infer one.

completion_observations.description: The player must observe all 14 quiz displays completed and the Orlando Smith claim condition before any separate normalized completion is recorded.
The player must separately observe the Historian Minas claim interaction; an external quest observation alone is insufficient.

does_not_prove: Arrival or travel to Varrock Museum.
Receipt of the Orlando Smith lecture.
Individual display answers or intermediate quiz progress.
Any quest start, partial quest state, or unrelated quest completion.
Rune Mysteries start or partial progress.
The Historian Minas interaction before it is separately observed.
